summary: Generation Quota Management System Testing (Iteration 21). Tested admin generation controls, creator generation status, and rate limiting. Fixed critical bug in system_settings persistence - JSON string parsing issue. All backend APIs working correctly. Admin UI and Creator UI properly displaying generation limits.

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: get_system_limits() not parsing JSON string from database - setting_value stored as JSON string but treated as dict
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added JSON parsing with json.loads() when setting_value is a string

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: update_system_limits() not merging with existing limits properly
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added proper merging of DEFAULT_LIMITS, existing limits, and new limits

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: TABLE_FIELDS missing system_settings table definition causing only 'id' to be returned
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added system_settings table fields: 'id setting_key setting_value updated_by updated_at'

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: user_profiles TABLE_FIELDS missing new generation columns
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added generation_status, daily_generation_limit, per_minute_limit, last_generation_at to user_profiles

Rate limiting working correctly - audition endpoint respects limits
Auto-distribute logic correctly calculates per-creator limits (RPD / active_creator_count)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Generation quota management system fully functional. Admin can set global limits (RPD, RPM, TPM), toggle auto-distribute, and enable/disable creators. Creators see their remaining generations (60/60) and audition credits (1496) on Characters page. Rate limiting properly implemented - audition endpoint returns 429 when limits exceeded. Frontend route is /admin-access/generation.
